title: Modjaz et al. 2014 / Liu & Modjaz 2014, arXiv:1405.1437 — SNID spectral templates of 70 stripped-envelope CCSNe (root: 1993J included as IIb template)
content: The CfA SNID template set contains 13 Type IIb supernovae out of 70 stripped-envelope core-collapse SNe, including SN 1993J. The paper notes for SN 1993J that its CfA spectra were taken at very late phases and advises caution when overwriting its templates-2.0 IIb template.
